content.text: Oh, "קרנות מחקות" — that's the S&P-type thing, closer to what I came for. Keep going.

I've been through it. Harel has a lot: the top says "105 כל המוצרים", 96 tracks across 7 types, plus 5 קרנות מחקות and 4 קרנות סל at the bottom. If I had to pick something, the S&P 500 tracks look like the thing. In the גמל להשקעה and השתלמות sections they're about 0.5–0.56% a year in fees and show 13.7% for 3 years and about 11.9% for 5. So am I sure? Fairly, on what's there. Not on what I'd actually do. What decided it is that the same S&P line, "13.7%" and "11.9%", keeps coming up in every section.

**How I went through it**
- Top screen: big "הראל", then "כל המוצרים של הראל" and a row of buttons ("105 כל המוצרים", "קופת גמל להשקעה 16", "קרן השתלמות 16" …). I didn't tap any.
- The first section was קופת גמל להשקעה. That sounds like an old-people pension thing to me, but the rows are basically the same as everywhere else. Fees went from "0.54%" up to "0.61%". Most of the return boxes just said "פחות מ־3 שנים". The ones with numbers that stood out were "מניות" at 24.04% / 14.64% and "עוקב מדד S&P 500" at 13.7% / 11.92%.
- קרן השתלמות, which I actually have: "0.41% עד 0.67%". "מניות" shows 21.45% for 3 years at 0.53%, and "עוקב מדד S&P 500" shows 13.71% at 0.5%.
- After that I was just scrolling: תגמולים, חיסכון לכל ילד, קרן חדשה מקיפה, קרן חדשה כללית, מרכזית לפיצויים. In the pension ones, the second fee line jumps to "1.47%" or "1.14%" and the first is tiny. I don't get why there are two lines.
- Bottom: קרנות מחקות and קרנות סל. These are the "S&P" things my friends talk about. "הראל מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" lists "0% קבוע", "0.1% משתנה", "0.025% נאמן". But there's no return number at all down there, so I can't compare them with the tracks above.
- "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל": just folds, didn't open any. Footer ignored.

**Words I didn't get**
- "מהחיסכון / מההפקדה": why there are two fees.
- "קבוע / משתנה / נאמן"
- "צוברת", "מנוטרלת מט"ח", "חשיפה לדולר", "4A / 4D"
- "מס גם על שינויי המטבע": it's in a reddish tag and it scared me off that one.
- The little rings with "מניות / מט"ח" percentages. I guessed teal is shares and yellow is dollars.
- "פחות מ־3 שנים": I guess there's no number because the track is too new?
- I'm not sure if 13.7% is per year or the total for 3 years. The header was small and I didn't read it.

**What wore me out**
Every single row repeats "מהחיסכון / מההפקדה", "מניות / מט"ח" and "3 שנים / 5 שנים". I had to read all of it again just to find the one number that changed. Saying it once would have been enough. Around the third screen I'd normally have closed it. Nothing tells you which one is for someone like me, and there are around 100 options that all look the same.
